onboarding.primaryEntry: directly approach and interact with any start-room connection target
onboarding.secondaryEntry: storage.planning may retain its existing contextual preview action but does not satisfy the Wave 10 discovery gate
onboarding.workbenchCausality: The first locked confirm teaches the Workbench requirement; after a naturally built Workbench, the player returns to a connection target to commit.

milestones.definition: A connection target becomes the single latched nearby target and its compact prompt is visible.
Interact opens the contextual connection popup with one focused preview action.
Submit opens ModulePreview on the candidate corresponding to the approached connection target.
Navigate has shown upper, side, and basement names, ghosts, connectors, and the common W2/D1 cost at least once each.
A locked confirm shows Workbench Required while preserving W2/D1, or the participant correctly identifies that gate without a hint.
If Cancel is attempted, preview returns one level to the same connection popup and root Cancel returns to the same field target and snapshot.

transitions: module.preview + Navigate -> module.preview on the next stable candidate
module.confirming + any failure reason -> module.preview with the same candidate and zero state change
module.confirming + READY -> field.return after one atomic commit
module.preview + Cancel -> popup.active with ui.module.expand focused
field.return + same target eligible -> prompt.near; otherwise -> prompt.far

inputSemantics.Interact: Open the single latched target popup only
inputSemantics.Navigate: Move popup focus or cycle the stable candidate order
inputSemantics.Submit: Open preview or validate the selected candidate
inputSemantics.Cancel: Return exactly one level: preview to popup, popup root to field
inputSemantics.deviceRule: Keyboard and gamepad use the same action IDs and state transitions; only glyphs and physical bindings differ.
inputSemantics.localeOrDeviceChange: Keep target, candidate, reason ID, popup focus, and ReturnSnapshot; re-render text and glyphs only.

failureTaxonomy.displayRule: Always compute geometry and economy separately. Show PROTOTYPE_LIMIT first after one successful commit; otherwise show the exact geometry reason when geometry is invalid, then the economy reason. Keep the selected module and full W2/D1 cost visible in every player-facing failure state.
failureTaxonomy.migrationRule: interaction.module.* keys are canonical. Current module.geometry.* and module.economy.* table keys may remain temporary aliases, but one state renders one localized message and logic never compares localized text.

quantitativeAcceptance: far/popup/preview has 0 context prompts; near has exactly 1; preview has exactly 1 cost/reason chip
NarrationCard gap is at least 12px and overlap with TopHUD or BottomHelp is 0 square pixels
expanded 12px bounds of the chip overlap Kim, the selected connector hotspot, and the required 48px walking corridor by 0 square pixels
the selected connector hotspot is fully on screen and at least 75 percent of the selected candidate ghost bounds is visible
ko, en, and qps-long have 0 clipping, tofu, hidden resource types, hidden counts, or ellipsis that removes the primary reason
a changed reason, locale, or glyph is visible on the next rendered frame without changing target, candidate, or state snapshot
a stationary three-second near target changes latch 0 times

playtest.collection: anonymous handwritten observation only; no telemetry, recording, or personal identifiers
cohortPass: MODULE_PREVIEW_OPEN by 50 seconds in at least 4 of 5 sessions, including at least one per locale and one per device
MODULE_ALL_SEEN by 75 seconds in at least 4 of 5 sessions, including at least one per locale and one per device
MODULE_GATE_UNDERSTOOD by 90 seconds in at least 4 of 5 sessions
post-session answers identify all three directions, Workbench requirement, and W2/D1 in at least 4 of 5 sessions
no session can open or commit a module from a far/global menu
all five sessions have zero crash, input lock, state-changing Cancel, duplicated prompt, or hidden primary reason

openQuestions: Which of the three existing connection targets is visually reached first under the final 1280x800 camera framing; the contract accepts any and does not adopt new art.
Physical gamepad glyph readability and focus parity remain UNVERIFIED until W10-03 and W10-04 are actually run.
The actual qps-long locale remains UNVERIFIED; the contract defines its layout gate but does not add a String Table in this design-only work.
